mechanism: Ritonavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase ampicillin levels, and ampicillin may reduce ritonavir absorption through enterohepatic circulation disruption and altered gastric pH effects.
action: Monitor for ampicillin toxicity (GI symptoms, pseudomembranous colitis) and ritonavir efficacy; consider alternative antibiotics if feasible or adjust ritonavir dosing under specialist supervision.
